candidates.source_name: Finančná spravodajská jednotka (FSJ), Prezídium Policajného zboru — hlavná stránka
candidates.why_relevant: Slovak FIU and AML supervisory/administrative authority under §5 zákona 297/2008; the primary publisher of AML guidance, obligations, sanctions practice and reporting rules that bind banks and payment institutions. Root hub for all FSJ subpages (usmernenia, povinnosti a sankcie, výročné správy, NHR).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML crawl of minv.sk query-string FSJ subpages + PDF harvest from /swift_data/source/policia/fsj/ and /fsj_biro/ paths; diff on document lists.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball from search results
queries_used: finančná spravodajská jednotka usmernenie povinné osoby zákon 297/2008
minv.sk finančná spravodajská jednotka výročná správa usmernenia povinné osoby

candidates.source_name: FSJ — Povinnosti a sankcie (obligations of obliged entities, fine ranges)
candidates.why_relevant: States the concrete statutory duties (CDD, STR/NOO reporting, 5-year retention, programme vlastnej činnosti, training) and the penalty ladder (up to EUR 1m generally; up to EUR 5m or 10% turnover for banks/financial institutions; personal fines for board members) — the compliance-cost baseline for banks and PSPs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML fetch + text diff.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search then direct fetch (fetched successfully)
queries_used: "minv.sk" fsj usmernenia povinné osoby stanoviská AML zoznam

candidates.source_name: FSJ — usmernenia a stanoviská (PDF guidance library, /fsj_biro/usmernenia/)
candidates.why_relevant: The FIU issues written usmernenia/stanoviská interpreting the AML Act for obliged entities (e.g. exemptions from the §18 confidentiality duty; non-face-to-face client identification and use of §12). These are the operative interpretations banks and payment firms must implement; they change with amendments.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest PDF links from FSJ HTML pages rather than assuming directory listing; hash PDFs to detect new/updated usmernenia.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search, snowball from PDF hits
queries_used: finančná spravodajská jednotka usmernenie povinné osoby zákon 297/2008

candidates.source_name: FSJ — výročné správy (FIU annual reports)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual FIU reports carry STR/NOO volumes by sector, inspection counts at banks and payment institutions, sanctioning statistics and typologies — the best quantitative time series on AML supervisory pressure in SK.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF pull with predictable filename pattern (VS_YYYY.pdf), table extraction.
queries_used: minv.sk finančná spravodajská jednotka výročná správa usmernenia povinné osoby

candidates.source_name: Správa z III. kola národného hodnotenia rizík ML/TF (National Risk Assessment, 3rd round)
candidates.why_relevant: The NRA sets the risk ratings that drive supervisory intensity and sectoral obligations for banks, payment institutions and VASPs; 3rd round covers 2020-2023. Directly predicts where inspections and new requirements land.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off PDF pull, re-check each NRA round; watch FSJ 'aktuality' for new rounds.
queries_used: národné hodnotenie rizík legalizácie príjmov z trestnej činnosti Slovenská republika NRA 2024

candidates.source_name: Národná stratégia boja proti legalizácii výnosov z trestnej činnosti, financovaniu terorizmu a proliferácie (do 2030)
candidates.why_relevant: Government-approved AML/CFT/CPF strategy (approved by uznesenie vlády č. 472/2025 per secondary reporting) — forward-looking action plan with owners and deadlines; the best single predictor of upcoming SK AML regulatory workstreams.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: PDF pull; cross-check against rokovania.gov.sk for the approving uznesenie and action-plan updates.
queries_used: národné hodnotenie rizík legalizácie príjmov z trestnej činnosti Slovenská republika NRA 2024

candidates.why_relevant: Numbered FSJ briefing sheets for obliged entities covering AML Act amendments and risk-assessment duties; a fast-moving channel where new obligations and effective dates appear before consolidated guidance.

candidates.source_name: Slov-Lex — zákon č. 297/2008 Z. z. (AML zákon), konsolidované znenie
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative consolidated text and amendment history of the Slovak AML Act, including the 2026 amendment (73/2026 Z. z.). Amendment metadata gives exact effective dates — the deadline backbone for banks and payment institutions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the predpis page for new amending acts; Slov-Lex also exposes structured eZbierka data — prefer that over HTML scraping.
queries_used: slov-lex slovensko legislatívny proces pripomienkové konanie AML zákon novela 297/2008 2026

candidates.why_relevant: Pripomienkové konanie portal: where MV SR files AML drafts and predbežné informácie before adoption — e.g. LP/2025/518 (AML amendment, shortened consultation Oct 2025) and PI/2026/51 (planned full replacement of 297/2008 aligned to the EU AML Regulation, effective ~10 July 2027). Earliest legal warning of new obligations and deadlines.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword-filtered polling of LP/PI listings for 'legalizácia', 'AML', 'sankcie', predkladateľ = Ministerstvo vnútra SR / Ministerstvo financií SR.

candidates.source_name: NBS — AML/CFT dohľad nad finančným trhom (AML supervision section)
candidates.why_relevant: NBS runs AML/CFT supervision of the financial market under zák. 747/2004 in parallel with FSJ's §5 supervision; this dedicated AML section (separate from prudential output) hosts metodické usmernenia a stanoviská, legislatíva AML/CFT, ML/TF risk assessment and AML supervisory cooperation pages relevant to banks and payment institutions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the four AML subpages plus the NBS Vestník for metodické usmernenia; diff on document lists.

candidates.source_name: NBS — Vestník NBS: metodické usmernenia (AML and payment-institution ICS)
candidates.why_relevant: The Vestník is the formal publication channel for NBS metodické usmernenia (e.g. MU 3/2019, 4/2019, MU 3/2023; MU 4/2014 on the internal control system of payment institutions and e-money institutions), which set expected AML control standards for banks and PSPs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor Vestník čiastky index; download MU PDFs. Note legacy www.nbs.sk/_img/documents/ URLs coexist with the new nbs.sk CMS — resolve both.

candidates.source_name: NBS — Výroky právoplatných rozhodnutí (published enforcement decisions)
candidates.why_relevant: Public register of final (and enforceable non-final) supervisory decisions, including AML fines against banks — e.g. a EUR 100,000 fine on a bank branch for CDD/UBO and unusual-transaction failures, final 22 May 2026 per press reporting. The only systematic view of actual AML enforcement severity in SK.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the decisions listing weekly; extract entity, legal basis (297/2008 vs sectoral), sanction amount, date of finality.

candidates.source_name: MONEYVAL (Council of Europe) — Slovak Republic country page and reports
candidates.why_relevant: MER adopted Sep 2020 put SK in enhanced follow-up; FURs adopted Nov 2022, Dec 2023 and Dec 2024 with technical-compliance re-ratings (reported as 5 C / 23 LC / 12 PC after the 2024 round). MONEYVAL announced in Jan 2026 that SK exits the 5th-round follow-up process, with the 6th-round on-site visit scheduled for October 2028 — a hard, datable driver of future SK AML reform.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watch MONEYVAL news feed and the SK country page; pull each FUR PDF and extract rating tables.

candidates.source_name: FATF-GAFI — Slovak Republic country page and FSRB follow-up reports
candidates.why_relevant: FATF mirrors MONEYVAL outputs for SK and hosts the FUR PDFs plus Recommendation-level ratings (incl. R.26 on regulation/supervision of financial institutions). Also the authoritative place for any grey-list risk signal affecting SK-facing correspondent banking.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the SK country detail page and Mutualevaluations listing; download the FUR PDFs.

candidates.source_name: AMLA — Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and CFT (EU, Frankfurt)

This supersedes large parts of the SK national AML regime — including the planned full replacement of zákon 297/2008.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll AMLA news, consultations and RTS/ITS publication pages; map each measure to SK transposition tasks.

brief: Slovak AML/CFT supervision touching banks and payment firms has two distinct national publishers: the Finančná spravodajská jednotka (FSJ) at the Ministry of Interior, which is both FIU and §5 supervisory/administrative authority under zákon 297/2008 (usmernenia, výročné správy, national risk assessment, penalty regime), and Národná banka Slovenska, which runs a separate AML/CFT supervisory track under zákon 747/2004 with its own metodické usmernenia, Vestník and published enforcement decisions. Legal deadlines are anchored on Slov-Lex (consolidated 297/2008 plus the 2026 amendment and the LP/PI pipeline pointing to a full replacement aligned with the EU AML Regulation from mid-2027), while sanctions competence sits with MF SR under zákon 289/2016 alongside MZV SR. External pressure is datable through MONEYVAL/FATF — 5th-round follow-up now closed with a 6th-round on-site visit slated for October 2028 — and through AMLA's Level 2/3 timetable and 2028 direct supervision of high-risk credit, payment and e-money institutions. Main weaknesses in the landscape are opaque minv.sk navigation with no feeds or sitemap, and the absence of any published SK register of sanctions-enforcement actions.
